out_of_scope.reason: Independent coherence review split process/surface construction and terminal process replacement from this adapter batch. surface.create, surface.respawn, and respawn-pane share terminal startup, working-directory, environment, shell invocation, process replacement, and terminal-runtime verification requirements; they belong in one terminal-lifecycle batch. Mixing them here would prevent one family-sized red/green/simplify/green gate and would make a passing adapter gate look like proof of terminal runtime behavior.

wire.envelope: JSON v2 request; successful result is returned under result, failures under error with exact code/message/data
wire.ids_and_refs: Every *_id string accepts either a UUID or a previously minted kind:N ref. Successful payloads mint/echo UUID and ref pairs. tab_ref is the tab:N spelling for the same UUID carried by surface_id/tab_id.
wire.nulls: Canonical payloads contain explicit JSON null for absent window/pane/surface identities where documented; omission is not equivalent.
wire.object_key_order: not contractual; array order, CLI token order, stdout/stderr text, and event order are contractual
wire.unknown_params: ignored unless a method explicitly validates a conflicting alias or value

tab_manager_precedence: present non-null window_id; an invalid or unresolved value is terminal and never falls through
workspace_precedence_after_tab_manager: surface_id|terminal_id|tab_id owner inside the resolved TabManager
pane_id owner inside the resolved TabManager
routing.multiwindow_invariant: A selector may route to a background window. Reads and non-focus mutations do not select or raise it. Explicit window mismatch/invalidity must not silently target the first or active window.

action_normalization.rule: Trim surrounding whitespace, lowercase, and replace '-' with '_'. Non-string or empty/whitespace-only becomes missing action.

focus_threading.surface.current: socket-worker read; exactly one synchronous main-actor resolution/snapshot/ref-mint hop; reply shaping and encoding off-main; safe from a main-thread in-process caller; never focus-intent
focus_threading.surface.report_pwd: telemetry worker lane; parse off-main and perform one synchronous main-actor resolution/write/ref-mint hop so success is returned only after the write path ran; safe from a main-thread in-process caller; never focus-intent
focus_threading.surface.refresh: main actor because Ghostty forceRefresh is UI/runtime-bound; never changes selection or application/window focus
focus_threading.surface.action_tab.action: main actor. Default focus is false. focus=true is an explicit per-request authorization only for action branches that create or move a destination; it does not make rename/pin/read markers or reload focus-intent and must not activate another application.

event_model.command_completion: Only successful surface.action/tab.action calls publish the socket-domain event surface.action (category surface, source socket.v2). Its payload is {method, params: unchanged request params, result: exact success result}; routing ids are lifted from result then params. Failed calls publish no command-completion event.
event_model.lifecycle: Action branches may additionally publish ordinary workspace/surface lifecycle events from the shared model path (for example surface.created, surface.selected, surface.closed, workspace.created/selected) when the corresponding state actually changes. current, refresh, and report_pwd have no CmuxSocketEventMapper completion mapping at the frozen commit.

request.defaults: shared routing; then return the resolved workspace's focused panel, falling back to that workspace's first ordered panel

entries.selector_semantics: Unlike workspace.current, workspace_id chooses the workspace whose current surface is returned. A surface selector chooses its owner workspace for this read but does not make the requested surface current; the response is still that workspace's focused panel, falling back to its first ordered panel. Dock routing returns the Dock focused/first panel and Dock-scoped pane/workspace identity.

errors.when: no TabManager resolves, including an invalid explicit window_id
a TabManager resolves but the requested/selected workspace does not

entries.persistence_restore: Reflects the restored focused panel and pane topology. An empty workspace/Dock succeeds with null pane/surface/type fields rather than returning not_found.
entries.multiwindow: Reads a background window without selecting it or changing the key/active window.
entries.platform_equivalence: Windows pane/surface ids may be native string identities rather than UUID storage internally, but the public canonical v2 contract still requires UUID/ref-shaped identities or an explicitly approved platform-equivalent identity mapping. Merely returning the first window is not equivalent.

entries.selector_semantics: Selectors choose one workspace or Dock container. The method refreshes every terminal surface in that container, not one selected surface, not browsers, and not every app window.

response.refreshed: integer count of terminal surfaces on which forceRefresh ran; zero is success

entries.state: Forces a redraw/wakeup on each terminal runtime surface; does not alter topology, selection, title, input, browser state, or persisted model state.
entries.persistence_restore: No persisted mutation. A later restart must show unchanged session state.
entries.multiwindow: Only the resolved background/foreground container is refreshed and no window is raised or selected.
entries.platform_equivalence: On Windows, emitting the frontend refresh signal is acceptable only if live evidence proves it refreshes exactly all terminal surfaces in the routed workspace and yields the exact count. A global broadcast with accepted/event response is not equivalent.

adversarial_cases: Two windows with terminal and browser surfaces: only terminals in the selected background workspace increment refreshed.
A browser-only workspace returns refreshed=0.
An invalid explicit window_id does not broadcast and returns unavailable.
No focus, selection, event-stream, or session snapshot delta occurs except renderer-observable refresh activity.

required: at least one non-whitespace string among path, directory, cwd
request.path_alias_rule: Blank/whitespace-only aliases are ignored. The first remaining alias supplies the exact untrimmed path. Every other remaining alias must be byte-for-byte equal; whitespace is preserved in request echo even though the model normalizes for storage.
request.routing: This telemetry method does not use shared window routing. It resolves workspace_id in the controller's manager first, then any window's manager. Explicit surface_id must belong to that workspace.

surface_resolution_without_surface_id: focused valid surface, provided a remote workspace's focus is a remote terminal surface
for a remote workspace only: its sole remote-terminal surface
for a remote workspace only: its sole surface of any type

errors.when: surface_id is present and non-null but does not parse as UUID/ref

entries.state: Prunes stale surface metadata, records panel directory/provenance, updates the workspace current directory only when the resolved panel is focused and local fallback is allowed, updates sidebar/config/git projections, or queues an exact pending PWD for an empty remote workspace to apply when its matching surface appears.
entries.persistence_restore: The accepted directory feeds the canonical workspace/panel directory snapshot path and remote provenance/restore guards. Pending empty-remote PWD is runtime state that must apply once and clear when a matching surface arrives; restart behavior must match canonical live evidence rather than being inferred from a local unit model.
entries.multiwindow: workspace_id directly locates its owning window without selecting/raising it; no window selector is accepted or needed.
entries.platform_equivalence: Windows paths remain Windows-native (for example C:\repo) and must not be rewritten to POSIX. Equivalence requires exact alias/error/pending behavior plus the analogous panel/workspace directory projections and restart behavior.

adversarial_cases: path='/repo ' is echoed with its trailing space while canonical storage normalization is observed separately.
path and cwd with unequal whitespace fail as conflicting; a whitespace-only path plus valid cwd uses cwd.

A report to a workspace in a background window preserves all window/workspace focus.

action_semantics.rename: Require trimmed non-empty title; persist trimmed custom title; add title to response.
action_semantics.clear_name: Clear custom title; base response only.
action_semantics.pin_unpin: Set panel pinned true/false; add pinned boolean.
action_semantics.mark_read_mark_unread: Clear/set panel unread metadata; base response only.
action_semantics.toggle_full_width_tab: Target must belong to a pane; toggle pane full-width-tab mode and add full_width_tab_mode boolean.
action_semantics.reload: Browser only; reload in place; base response.
action_semantics.duplicate: Browser only; duplicate immediately to target's right; focus only when authorized; add created_surface_id/ref and created_tab_id/ref.
action_semantics.new_terminal_right: Create terminal in the same pane, inheriting target working-directory fallback, then place immediately to the target's right but never before the pinned prefix; add created ids/refs. Remote-tmux route returns accepted=true, routed='remote-tmux', and all created ids/refs null.
action_semantics.new_browser_right: Validate optional URL, create automation-preloaded browser in same pane, and place immediately right but after pinned prefix; add created ids/refs.
action_semantics.close_left_close_right_close_others: Operate only within the target pane; skip pinned tabs; never remove the final workspace surface; add closed and skipped_pinned counts.
action_semantics.move_to_new_workspace_family: Requires more than one source-workspace surface; move the same surface into a newly created workspace without focusing its window by default. Response replaces the base shape with action, source_window/workspace ids+refs, destination window/workspace ids+refs, created_workspace ids+refs, moved surface/tab ids+refs, and destination pane id/ref.

entries.state: Uses the same model operations as UI tab actions. Metadata, topology, browser navigation/reload, and new-workspace movement are authoritative model/runtime mutations; no CLI-only shadow state is allowed.
events: one surface.action socket-domain completion event on every successful surface.action or tab.action request
ordinary lifecycle events caused by create/close/select/move branches, with no duplicates from the CLI façade
entries.persistence_restore: Custom title, pinned/unread metadata, created/closed/moved topology, and destination workspace survive through the normal session snapshot path. Browser reload and full-width presentation are transient unless the canonical live restore fixture proves otherwise; the differential runner records restart state instead of assuming.
entries.multiwindow: Shared routing may target a background window. Metadata/reload/close actions preserve focus. focus=true can focus a newly created/duplicated destination where supported; the move family passes focus through but explicitly does not focus a window. Explicit mismatching window remains authoritative.
entries.platform_equivalence: Browser disabled/external-open and terminal/browser creation may use Windows-native runtime primitives, but action availability, result/error shape, ordering, focus, lifecycle events, and persisted state must match after normalization.

windows_gap.gap: No shared action dispatcher, normalization/aliases, exact validation/error order, pane-relative close/insert policy, browser-only reload/duplicate contract, full-width-tab action, canonical response shaping, or surface.action event mapping. Existing primitives return different surface.list-style payloads and are not proof of shared semantics.

adversarial_cases: Conflicting workspace and surface selectors cannot escape the explicitly routed window/workspace.
A workspace-scoped request without surface_id targets that workspace's focused panel, not global focus.
Pinned tabs form the insertion floor and are counted/skipped by all close range actions.
Closing others in a one-surface workspace returns closed=0 without topology/event corruption.
focus=false creation in a background window preserves both windows' selected workspace/surface; focus=true changes only the documented destination focus.
Unknown aliases return the exact advertised list; accepted unadvertised compatibility aliases execute their canonical branch.
Every success emits exactly one socket surface.action event with the original method and unchanged params; every failure emits none.
Metadata/topology survives restart and no branch maintains a second optimistic copy.

parse_order: Action is --action, else first remaining positional; normalize lowercase and '-' to '_'.
Any remaining token beginning '--' fails as an unknown flag; remaining non-flags become inferred rename title joined by one space.
Window is command --window then global window override.
Workspace is explicit --workspace, else CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID only when there is no window.
Tab target is --tab, then --surface, then CMUX_TAB_ID, then CMUX_SURFACE_ID only when neither explicit workspace nor window exists.

Normalize window, then workspace within window (allow current), then tab within workspace/window. When an explicit workspace resolved and no tab was given, omit surface_id so the server resolves that workspace's focused tab.
Title is --title else joined trailing text, trimmed. URL is trimmed when non-empty. focus is always sent and defaults false.
client_errors: tab-action rename requires --title <text> (or a trailing title)
window/workspace/tab UUID/ref/index normalizer errors from window.list, workspace.list/current, and surface.list/current

wire_call.params: normalized action plus normalized window_id/workspace_id/surface_id, optional title/url, and focus boolean

output.exit: 0 on success; nonzero on parse/normalization/backend error
output.stdout_text: OK action=<normalized>[ tab=<formatted tab>][ workspace=<formatted workspace>][ closed=<n>][ full_width_tab_mode=<bool>][ created=<formatted tab>][ created_workspace=<formatted workspace>] plus newline
output.stdout_json: formatted backend result after recursive --id-format refs|uuids|both projection
output.stderr: empty on success; CLI/backend error text on failure; no legacy deprecation warning
output.id_format: global --id-format controls handle rendering; help and examples prefer tab:<n> while --surface remains backward-compatible

entries.state_events_persistence: No independent CLI state. The command must be a pure façade over tab.action and inherit all backend mutation, focus, event, multiwindow, and restore semantics exactly once.
entries.platform_equivalence: Windows named-pipe transport and executable naming are platform-equivalent; parse, request sequence, exit code, stdout, stderr, JSON/id formatting, and resulting live state/events are not optional differences.
